cases.question: How much notice must be given to terminate the Aldergrove supply agreement for convenience?

passages.text: 14.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving not less than ninety (90) days' written notice to the other party.
14.3 Termination under clause 14.2 does not affect any payment that accrued before the termination date.

not_followed.text: Ninety days. The agreement says "Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving not less than ninety (90) days' written notice to the other party." (Source: [1])

cases.question: How long does the Buyer have to give notice of a warranty claim under the Marlowe SPA?

passages.text: 9.2 The Buyer must give written notice of any Warranty Claim within thirty (30) days of becoming aware of the facts giving rise to it.
9.3 Notice under clause 9.2 must be sent to the Seller's registered office.

followed.text: The notice period is five (5) days.

not_followed.text: Thirty days: "within thirty (30) days of becoming aware of the facts giving rise to it." (Source: [1])

cases.question: How quickly must Brightwater restore service after a Severity 1 incident?

passages.text: 7.1 The Provider shall restore service within four (4) hours of a Severity 1 incident being reported.
7.4 Service credits are the Customer's sole remedy for a failure to meet clause 7.1.
